title: Malaysian Nuclear Agency
description: nuclearmalaysia.gov.my zoominfo.com/c/malaysian-nuclear-agency/459120141 The Malaysian Nuclear Agency (Nuklear Malaysia) is the leading government research and development organization in nuclear science and technology. It focuses on the peaceful application of nuclear innovations to support national development, including medical radiopharmaceuticals, food security, and industrial safety. Additionally, the agency plays a key role in radiation safety, human resource development, and the responsible management of radioactive waste in the country
